features: Treasury Guardian Widget MVP: introduced the new predictive treasury assistant on the dashboard that calculates liquidity overdraft at 30 days and classifies risk (Green, Yellow, Red).
Dynamic Call-to-Actions (Smart UX): the widget proactively suggests contextual actions based on the cash flow scenario (e.g. 'Issue New Installments' or 'Check or Remind Inflows').
Liquidity and Initial Balances Reconciliation: resolved misalignment between the widget and the trial balance by incorporating the initial cash balance into the available liquidity calculation.
Exact Expected Inflows Calculation: corrected the inflow estimation algorithm to exclusively extract actual payments received in double-entry bookkeeping, guaranteeing flawless financial projections.
Withholding Tax Statistics: fixed a statistical issue in the payments dashboard that kept the withholding tax count at zero, now calculating it proportionally at the time of payment registration.

Action Inbox for Extraordinary Plans & Sync: extended Action Inbox support to Extraordinary Installment Plans (immediate generation of tasks for installment issuance and inflow checks) and resolved a bug that failed to delete old events upon full regeneration of an approved plan.
